Sub Querysave(Source As Notesuidocument, Continue As Variant) TempNum$ = Source.FieldGetText("INO") TempStatus$ = Source.FieldGetText("CA")
Dim ws As NotesUIWorkSpace Set ws = New NotesUIWorkSpace Dim uidoc As NotesUIDocument Set uidoc=ws.currentDocument
If Trim$(TempNum$) = "" And Trim$(TempStatus$) = "Submitted" Then Dim session As NotesSession Set session = New NotesSession Dim db As NotesDatabase Set db = session.CurrentDatabase Dim view As NotesView Set view = db.GetView("lookup")
Dim doc As NotesDocument Dim p As Variant Dim c As Integer Set doc = view.GetFirstDocument
If doc Is Nothing Then 'Start Assign the running number to 0000 if document does not exist Set doc = New NotesDocument(db) Call doc.ReplaceItemValue("Form","RunningProfile") Call doc.ReplaceItemValue("INO","000") Call doc.Save(True,False) p = 0 Set uidoc=ws.currentDocument Set doc=uidoc.document c = 1 Else p=doc.GetItemValue("INO") Set uidoc=ws.currentDocument Set doc=uidoc.document c = Val(p(0)) + 1 End If
uidoc.GoToField "INO"
Dim x As String x = Trim(Str(c)) Do While Len(x) < 3 x = "0" & Trim(x) Loop uidoc.FieldSetText"INO",x End If End Sub

Set db = sess.CurrentDatabase out = "DATABASE : " & db.Title & Chr(10) out = out & "PATH : " & db.FilePath & Chr(10) out = out & "DATE : " & CStr(Now()) & Chr(10) out = out & String(60, "=") & Chr(10)

forms = "" : subforms = "" : pages = "" : framesets = "" : outlines = ""
noteID = ncForms.GetFirstNoteID() Do While noteID <> "" Set note = db.GetDocumentByID(noteID) title = note.GetItemValue("$TITLE")(0) flags = note.GetItemValue("$Flags")(0) If InStr(flags, "r") > 0 Then framesets = framesets & " " & title & Chr(10) ElseIf InStr(flags, "W") > 0 Then pages = pages & " " & title & Chr(10) ElseIf InStr(flags, "U") > 0 Then subforms = subforms & " " & title & Chr(10) ElseIf InStr(flags, "O") > 0 Then outlines = outlines & " " & title & Chr(10) Else forms = forms & " " & title & Chr(10) End If noteID = ncForms.GetNextNoteID(noteID) Loop
